notes.title: Product Version 0.3.0 / Trial Version 1.2.11 Released
notes.content:
[p]Add stories:

Bug fixes, Adjustment of specifications: 
#Bug fixes:
 -Fixed the effect of the skill "Fire Ball".
 -Fixed the effect of the item "Drop Up Potion" not being reflected correctly.
 -Fixed a bug where a quest that had already been cleared would reappear in the quest list under certain conditions.
 -Other minor behavior fixes.

#Text correction:
 -Fixed some text errors.
 -The wording of some descriptions has been adjusted.

#Balance adjustment:
 -Adjusted the prices of some existing shop items.[/p]

notes.title: Product Version 0.2.1 / Trial Version 1.2.10 Released
notes.content:
[p]Bug fixes:
-Fixed an issue where the screen would not return to normal if it became dark during a battle event when the option "Milu's Advice" was off. Also, fixed so that if you saved in that state, the screen would be restored when loading.
-Fixed some areas where the turn was not displayed at the start of battle.
-Fixed some areas where shadows were not appearing correctly.
-Fixed some text errors.
-Other minor behavior fixes.[/p]

notes.title: Product Version 0.2.0 / Trial Version 1.2.9 Released
notes.content:
Add stories:
※Note: There are some items that cannot currently be created through synthesis.
They will be able to be created in the next story addition update.

Bug fixes, Adjustment of specifications:
#Bug fixes:
 -During battle, there was a memory leak in the state icon processing, so this has been fixed to  prevent this from happening.
 -Fixed some battle logs not displaying correctly.
 -Fixed an issue where some existing events would continue even if you lost.
 -Other minor behavior fixes.

#Text correction:
 -Fixed some text errors.
 -The wording of some descriptions has been adjusted.
 -Adjustments to some existing event conversations.
 -Some adjustments to the Daiyousei's profile.

#Specification adjustment
 -In the Monster Encyclopedia, add whether the skill is physical or magical under each element.
 -Organize the display order of items.
 -Adjusted camera behavior.
 -The method for adjusting the abilities of strengthened enemies has been changed from applying a status to increasing their level.
 -Changed the levels of some existing event enemies. (※ This adjustment will not affect ability values.)
 -The number of materials required will increase or decrease based on the synthesis level.
 -Changed so that synthesis can be done even if the synthesis level is insufficient.

#Balance adjustment
 -Adjusted the strength, behavior, EXP gain, and gold gain of some existing enemies.
 -Added products to some existing shops.
 -Adjusted the prices of some existing shop items.
 -Adjusted the effects and changed the names of some existing equipment and items.
 -Adjusted the item drop rate in some existing treasure chests.
 -Changed the element of some existing skills.

notes.title: Product Version(Early Access) Release
notes.content:
"Fairies Praying To Heaven 2" went on sale today.

I hope to create an enjoyable game together with all players.
I would be very happy if you could give us your impressions and feedback after playing the game.
I am aware that there are still many areas where the game needs improvement, so I appreciate your support.

My immediate plan is to unlock all quests that were implemented in the pre-release version by the end of November, and to unlock new maps that are currently in development.
(※Pre-release version: The old version that was distributed at sales events.)

notes.title: Notice of postponement of product release date
notes.content:
We are currently working hard on the production, but considering the progress, we have decided that it would be difficult to release it in August, so we have decided to postpone it to October.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please wait for a while.

notes.title: Trial Version Release
notes.content:
In conjunction with the Steam Next festival, we released a trial version to the extent possible.

Although we have only released a portion of the content so far, we will update the trial version to the extent planned as soon as we are ready too.

If you find any bugs, please feel free to contact us on the bulletin board.
